== Title ==
<span lang="ja">オルデラン</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-281o-PSA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここを支配しているなら、支配しているデス・スターの位置１つにつき、フォース消耗を＋１する。</span>

'''Light Side:''' The printed text box is blank.<ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
No lore is printed on this card.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Dark Side:''' If you control here, add 1 to the Force drain for each Death Star site you control.

'''Light Side:''' The printed text box is blank.

The original English card explicitly says the controlled Death Star sites must be on table. The Japanese text describes them as sites you control.<ref>[[:File:Premiere-D-alderaan.gif|Original English printed face]].</ref>
